  - pwsh -Command "Invoke-WebRequest -Uri 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/blenback/profi/main/other_content.yaml' -OutFile 'publications/Other_content.yaml'"
listing:
  - id: Journal-articles
    template: publication_yearly.ejs
    contents:
    - publications/publications.yaml
  - id: Theses
    template: publication.ejs
    contents:
    - publications/Theses.yaml
  - id: Student-theses
    template: publication.ejs
    contents:
    - publications/Student_theses.yaml
  - id: Other-content
    template: gallery.ejs
    contents: 
    - publications/Other_content.yaml
